all_en.text: Fragile Trade

zh.text: 吴人的海船把南洋的稻米、远方的木材和各国的货物运进南朝，内陆的工坊、营伍与学堂也早已依赖这些往来。旧日各府可以据地自守，今日停下一处港口、扣住一批货物，损失便会沿着商路传到许多人的家中。\n\n南京与杭州争论帝统的时候，商人同样在衡量自己的前程。[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]的官署需要纸张，军队需要粮饷与军械，工坊中的人需要靠工钱生活。我们当与愿意往来的诸邦重续交游，也须让本国的生产支撑起这些生计。商路能否经受朝争，将决定我们届时有多少余力。

en.text: Wu’s ships carry grain and raw materials between distant ports. The workshops, garrisons and schools of the southern countries have come to depend on that traffic. A closed harbour or a detained cargo can now take livelihoods away far beyond its own shores.\n\nWhile Nanjing and Hangzhou dispute the dynasty, merchants consider their own future. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] needs paper for its offices, supplies for its soldiers and employment for its people. We must renew our trading connections and sustain the production at home that gives us room to act.

zh.text: 过去一季，[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]的工坊与营伍有货可购，学堂、官署和厂场也逐渐补齐了人手。商人重新熟悉了往来的门路，各州的人们得以靠生产与买卖维持生活。\n\n海内外的朝争还在继续。那些装着货物驶离码头的船只，为我们留下了继续经营的本钱。

en.text: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]已经完成本轮通商筹办。官署、军队与工坊所需的关键商品保持供应，受检的学校、营伍或生产设施已有人员任事，各州的生计也经受了这一季的检验。\n\n商人熟悉了往来的门路，官员掌握了本国生产的长短。此后的建设与交涉，可以从这些实际经验继续做起。

zh.text: 共和国的沿海城镇因移民与商船而兴盛。反抗吴人的战争使东洲诸邦走到一起，北朝的盟约又为我们的货物打开了新的销路。港口中的装卸、工坊中的生产和各州的赋税，已经随着这些往来紧紧相连。\n\n如今南朝争位的消息越海而来。商人要打听货源，船主忧心航路，工人仍等着每周的工钱。无论继续经营共同市场，还是由共和国另定通商安排，我们都须先稳住自己的生产与生计。

en.text: Immigrants and merchant ships built the republic’s coastal towns. War against Wu brought its states together; the northern alliance opened further markets. Work in the harbours, production in the mills and provincial revenue now depend upon these connections.\n\nNews of the southern dispute crosses the ocean. Whether we continue in the shared market or arrange our own trade, production and livelihoods at home must endure.

zh.text:
#bold 货源#!
纸张、工具、小武器无本国短缺，价格涨幅不超过#v 50%#!；东洲另需硬木。

#bold 工场与人手#!
所需建筑各有至少一座雇员达到#v 75%#!，且不缺生产投入。湖广为大学与军营；四川为工具厂，以及铁矿或伐木场；广西为纸厂与伐木场；东洲为港口与官署。招工困难时可查看[concept_pop_qualifications]、[concept_building_wage]与原料供应。

#bold 生计#!
全国无业劳动力不超过#v 12%#!；劳动力至少#v 5万#!的州不超过#v 20%#!。自给农民属于有业人口。全国无饥荒，粮食无本国短缺且涨价不超过#v 25%#!。
现有无业劳动力：#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployed').GetValue|0] / [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_workforce').GetValue|0]#!（#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployment').GetValue|%1]#!）；超过地方失业界线的州：#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_critical_states').GetValue|0]#!。

#bold 商路安定#!
确定联络伙伴或依靠本国商帮，四项条件连续维持#v 12周#!。战争、破产、市场改变或任一条件不满足，连续周数重新计算。

en.text:
#bold Latest refresh#!
Unemployed workforce: #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployed').GetValue|0] / [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_workforce').GetValue|0]#! (#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployment').GetValue|%1]#!)
States beyond the local unemployment limit: #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_critical_states').GetValue|0]#!

#bold Employment requirements#!
Unemployed workers may be at most #v 12%#! of the national workforce. In states with at least #v 50,000#! workers, the limit is #v 20%#!. Subsistence workers count as employed. Statistics refresh weekly and when arrangements change; completion checks current conditions.

Each required school, barracks, workshop or administrative facility must have at least one building staffed to #v 75%#! without input shortages. Check its hiring tooltip for [concept_pop_qualifications], [concept_building_wage] and [concept_good]. Education, suitable vacancies and market supplies can support occupational transitions. There must be no famine, no local grain shortage and no more than a #v 25%#! grain price increase.

Continue in the shared market, approach a foreign partner, or arrange purchases domestically. All four requirements must hold for #v 12 consecutive weeks#!; war, market changes or failed requirements restart the count.

zh.text: 百年明祚终难延

en.text: A Century of Ming Fortune Nears Its End

baseline_zh.text: 百年明祚终难延

candidate_en.text: A Century of Ming Fortune Nears Its End

all_zh.text: 百年明祚终难延

all_en.text: A Century of Ming Fortune Nears Its End

zh.text:
明字大旗或许在这个地球上象征着东方世界的无限荣光。日月照临下前进的北明诸霸用比汉唐更加激进的尺度丈量自己和世界，永久地改变了人类对于世界岛的势力划分。但对于经历了北明数百年藩镇政治的人们来说，朱姓的王朝给神州大地也带来了与它荣光相等的血与泪。

就算将西历1433-1549年看作统一时期的南京御用文人，在面对尔后至今长达三个世纪的内外战争时，也只能侧过脸去。而在自西北吹来的玉门新风——陈东阳及其国人共和党人在吴王郑钦的支持下进行了自上而下的改革后，朱姓皇族及其羽翼下明廷藩臣勋旧的奢靡反动就更加惹眼。土地、债契、门第。共和党人口中这些人吃掉人用的工具，在十室九空的和平之后，也愈发地为人们所厌弃和批判。

值此千年未有之变局时刻，大明联邦的人们在惶恐和义愤中举目南望。

杭州，一个象征着明人对于新大陆、欧罗巴、大食世界以及更偏远角落探索开拓的城市。在那里，力挽狂澜从牧氏野心中拯救了明朝的郑氏家族正在嘈杂迷乱的舆论场斗战中静坐，等待着历史湍流的下一次激荡。

en.text:
The Ming banner may still symbolize boundless eastern glory on this Earth. Under sun and moon, the hegemonic states of Northern Ming measured themselves and the world on a scale even more radical than Han and Tang, permanently reshaping power across the World Island. Yet for people who endured centuries of Ming-era regional warlord politics, the royal house of Zhu brought blood and tears equal to its glory.

After a new Yumen wind blew from the northwest - where Chen Dongyang and his Zhongren (Civic) Republicans, supported by Prince Zheng Qin of Wu, launched top-down reforms - the reaction of the Zhu house, old court retainers, and hereditary magnates became ever more glaring. Land, debt contracts, forced conscription: these, denounced by republicans as tools by which men consume men, came under sharper criticism for leaving villages empty and broken.

At this once-in-a-millennium turning point, the wise and cunning might look to the south. Hangzhou - city of Ming exploration into the New World, Europe, the Islamic sphere. That's the seat of the prince of Wu that once saved the dynasty from northerner ambitions now sits amid a chaotic arena of public opinion, waiting for history's torrent to surge again.

zh.text: 相较于矛盾的全面爆发，富有决断力的南朝政治家们凭借一系列果断地决策延缓了帝国的瓦解，消弭了共和派和保守派之间的剑拔弩张。虽然如此，这个从四百年的藩镇政治中爬出来的幸存者也失去了很多。战争与和平对峙的年代结束了。但反对者、藩国旧民之间的地域歧视、新的激进派政治团体仍在新时代的阴影下活动者。让这个国家乃至整个东方世界向未来前进的道路蒙上了一层厚重的迷雾。

en.text: Compared with total explosion of contradictions, decisive Southern Court statesmen delayed imperial collapse through a sequence of hard choices, easing direct confrontation between republicans and conservatives. Even so, this survivor crawling out of four centuries of warlord politics also lost much. The age of war-peace confrontation ended. Yet opponents, regional discrimination among old feudatory populations, and new radical groups still move in the shadows of the new era, casting a heavy fog over this country - and the whole East - on its road to the future.

Yet opponents, regional discrimination among old feudatory populations, and new radical groups still move in the shadows of the new era, casting a heavy fog over this country's road to the future.

baseline_zh.text: 相较于矛盾的全面爆发，富有决断力的南朝政治家们凭借一系列果断地决策延缓了帝国的瓦解，消弭了共和派和保守派之间的剑拔弩张。虽然如此，这个从四百年的藩镇政治中爬出来的幸存者也失去了很多。战争与和平对峙的年代结束了。但反对者、藩国旧民之间的地域歧视、新的激进派政治团体仍在新时代的阴影下活动者。让这个国家向未来前进的道路蒙上了一层厚重的迷雾。

zh.text:
西元1678年春，时为北明吴国公的大明南京留守使、南京礼部尚书的（吴武宗）郑昭在他在海内外的一系列军事胜利后，单方面向朝廷上书，准备进京觐见大明天子。当是时，在三十年前的大宪战争中大获全胜的天津燕主及其国势还如烈火烹油。堪称北明战国末期的天下之雄。但郑氏的执拗战胜了朝臣的规劝和敌人的威胁。终于在同年六月成行。

这次觐见是一场北明从藩镇时期到诸侯时期近三百年来都未有人见过的盛大巡游。虽然吴国主在燕、秦、齐等势力的胁迫下，最终只带了5000卫士和一些官员随行。但在这队伍中包罗了吴国海陆军事力量在那个时代的全部精锐，南洋的海兵、倭国的刀牌手、女真掷弹兵的早期营队，甚至还包括一个由“极东殷人”流亡贵族组成的，向中国皇帝伸冤借兵的队伍。并携带着吴人在这个地球上纵横百年来所获得无数珍宝，以及又用了近万名民夫运送的安南、高棉贡米。与之相对的，则是在藩镇节度使制度下被小规模械斗和转运使卡要下，四时常乱，在饥荒边缘长久徘徊的中原。

在郑昭的觐见使团归来后。他当即改其称号为”至尊“，吴国随即见证了一个南北流民向自己及殖民地不断涌入的快速发展时期。而在那之后，郑昭及其继承者也开始以更加严苛的力度推进集权主义的“专权变法”及土地商品化改革。并最终稳固了我们作为南朝尊主，总领万国的基业。吴人前进的脚步从未停下，直至今天......

all_en.text:
In spring 1678, Zheng Zhao - Duke of Wu in Northern Ming, Nanjing regent and minister of rites - after a chain of military victories at home and abroad, petitioned the court to enter the capital and pay homage to the Ming Son of Heaven. At that time, the Tianjin Prince of Yan, victor of the great constitutional war thirty years earlier, still blazed in power. Yet Zheng's stubbornness overcame counsel and threats alike, and the journey took place that June.

This audience became a grand procession unseen for nearly three centuries, from warlord age to feudal-prince age in Northern Ming. Though coerced by Yan, Qin, and Qi powers into bringing only 5,000 guards and officials, Zheng's train contained elite land-sea forces of Wu's era: marines from the Southern Seas, Japanese shield-swordsmen, early Jurchen grenadier units, even an exiled noble group of 'Far Eastern Yin people' seeking troops from the Chinese emperor. It carried treasures won by Wu over a century of global campaigns, plus Annamese and Khmer tribute rice borne by nearly ten thousand laborers. In stark contrast stood the famine-struck Central Plains under transport extortion and local armed strife.

After returning, Zheng Zhao at once took the title 'Supreme One.' Wu then entered rapid growth as refugees from north and south poured into its core and colonies. Zheng and his successors pushed harsh centralizing 'autocratic reform' and land commodification, ultimately securing our foundation as Southern Court overlord directing all nations. Wu's march has never ceased - to this very day...

zh.text: 陈东阳（字满越）（1772-[Date.GetString|v]）是西秦大革命时期的国人主义共和思想的代表人物，也是短命的革命共和国的开国元勋。在被迫逃离自己建立的国家后，陈东阳与南方的进步派合作，以南明首辅的身份又成为南明近代化改革的主要领袖。\n\n然而，改革带来的不只有繁荣，还有巨大的政治动荡和许多地方有力人士的抵抗。随着改革在政治上和经济上的工作基本完成，郑钦及其盟友开始对陈东阳集团无法控制的共和派理想感到厌烦。曾言“予取予求，孤当自专”的郑钦在今年早些时候罢免了在集权改革中逐渐和自己分道扬镳的陈东阳，并密令归化和族官员郑（德川）家齐监视其行动。最终，[Date.GetString|v]，陈东阳离开大陆前往极东洲讲学时，吴王豢养的和族死士郑六郎在航船中毒杀了这位青史留名的政治家。

en.text: Chen Dongyang (courtesy name Manyue, 1772-[Date.GetString|v]) was a representative figure of civic republican thought during the Western Qin Great Revolution and a founding hero of its short-lived revolutionary republic. Forced into exile from the state he built, he later cooperated with southern progressives and, as chief minister of Southern Ming, became a key leader of modernization reform.\n\nYet reform brought not only prosperity but also severe political turmoil and resistance from powerful local interests. After core political and economic reforms were largely completed, Zheng Qin and allies grew weary of republican ideals beyond Chen's control. Having once declared 'what I desire, I shall take and hold alone,' Zheng Qin dismissed Chen earlier this year and secretly ordered Zheng (Tokugawa) Jiaqi to monitor him. Ultimately, on [Date.GetString|v], while Chen sailed to lecture in the Far East Continent, a retained Wa assassin named Zheng Liulang poisoned him aboard ship.

陈东阳死后，追随他的南方共和派几乎立刻就陷入了相互指责和争论中。与陈东阳同为“共和四君子”，主张却更为温和的户部尚书邓明舆及其门生倒向了郑钦和南府。曾任湖广布政使的郑雕锦则带领一部分人离开南京。前往进步派余党萧虎力治下的四川。

all_en.text:
Chen Dongyang (courtesy name Manyue, 1772-[Date.GetString|v]) was a leading civic republican thinker and founding hero of the short-lived Western Qin revolutionary republic. Exiled from his own state, he worked with southern progressives and became chief architect of Southern Ming modernization as chief minister.

Yet reform brought fierce political upheaval and resistance from local power holders. As reform reached completion, Zheng Qin and allies came to fear republican ideals beyond their control. On [Date.GetString|v], while Chen departed for lecture tours in the Far East Continent, an unidentified Wa ronin shot him dead on deck with a short firearm.

After Chen's death, southern republicans who followed him immediately fell into accusation and factional dispute. Deng Mingyu, minister of revenue and fellow 'Four Gentlemen of the Republic,' moved toward Zheng Qin and the Southern Office. Zheng Diaojin, former administrator of Huguang, led part of the faction west to Sichuan under Xiao Huli.

zh.text:
南明政权后期，武装力量主要分为西府、南府两大部分。其中的西府军队没有南府郑氏这样独断的政治领袖，而实际上是一个由四川蜀藩、湖北楚藩、广西淮藩为首的松散联盟。曾几何时，郑雕锦正是其中那颗冉冉升起的明星——朱班博麾下最有力的智囊。后者的人格魅力和军事指挥能力足以让他背叛自己腐朽的家族。成为国人共和派在南方的坚定信徒。

然而，仿佛是老天爷看厌了明朝故事。陈东阳、朱班博这两尊时代的巨擎几乎是毫无征兆地倒下了。曾经追随他从西安走到漠南，再从漠南回到西安，又从那里来到江水之南的那些人也各奔前程。转眼间，这世上唯一还能看到共和制度塔尖的人仿佛就剩下了他一个。

好吧！迈向未来的梦想家们在法国失败了，秦国失败了，明国眼看也要失败下去。但众所周知，在历史上正义的一方总是要不断地失败下去。但只要这是真正顺着历史的潮流的事情。做下去，最终都会成功。就像岳飞、文天祥做不到的事情，朱重八就可以做到。而郑雕锦甚至不必像前人那样牺牲自己，因为在西方的崇山峻岭中，恐怕还有一个他的老朋友。

en.text:
In late Southern Ming, armed forces were chiefly divided between Western Office and Southern Office. Unlike Zheng's Southern Office, the Western Office lacked a single dominant political leader and functioned as a loose alliance led by Sichuan Shu, Hubei Chu, and Guangxi Huai. Once, Zheng Diaojin was its rising star - foremost strategist under Zhu Banbo. Banbo's charisma and command could make men betray decaying lineage and embrace civic republicanism in the south.

Yet Heaven seemed tired of the Ming story: Chen Dongyang and Zhu Banbo, two pillars of the age, fell without warning. The men who followed Diaojin from Xi'an to Monan, back to Xi'an, and then south of the great river scattered to their own fates. In a blink, it seemed only he remained who could still glimpse the summit of republican order.

So be it. Dreamers of the future failed in France, failed in Qin, and Ming now seems destined to fail as well. Justice in history is known to fail again and again - but if the cause truly follows history's tide, persistence will one day prevail. What Yue Fei and Wen Tianxiang could not do, Zhu Yuanzhang did. And Diaojin may not even need such sacrifice, for somewhere in the western mountains there may still be an old friend.

In late Southern Ming, armed forces were chiefly divided between Western Office and Southern Office. Unlike Zheng's Southern Office, the Western Office lacked a single dominant political leader and functioned as a loose alliance led by Sichuan Shu, Hubei Chu, and Guangxi Huai. Once, Zheng Diaojin was its rising star - foremost strategist under Zhu Banbo. Banbo's charisma and command could make men betray decaying lineage and embrace civic republicanism in the south.

Yet Heaven seemed tired of the Ming story: Chen Dongyang and Zhu Banbo, two pillars of the age, fell without warning. The men who followed Diaojin from Xi'an to Monan, back to Xi'an, and then south of the great river scattered to their own fates. In a blink, it seemed only he remained who could still glimpse the summit of republican order.

So be it. Dreamers of the future failed in France, failed in Qin, and Ming now seems destined to fail as well. Justice in history is known to fail again and again - but if the cause truly follows history's tide, persistence will one day prevail. What Yue Fei and Wen Tianxiang could not do, Zhu Yuanzhang did. And Diaojin may not even need such sacrifice, for somewhere in the western mountains there may still be an old friend.

zh.text: 大吴天演元年（1850年），礼议（会）以吴国郑氏代明而立。蜀王朱深橞、广西（淮）王靖堙反。朱靖堙登基践祚，改元“复昭”，号称“天日复昭”。礼议（会）以曾国藩、左宗棠、郑（德川）家齐、吴（井伊）直弼讨之。三月灭淮，次年，蜀将萧虎力病逝，重臣魏鉴死守成都旧城，持剑骂贼死。蜀王南奔大理。\n\n成都既克，西兵星散。曾、吴遂使南兵封闭川中州县三日，搜检山河，野外有民人健者皆可杀。令既下，成都、剑阁、眉州等皆为众军强夺。有不从者无论何处受捕，皆为屠戮。金沙水赤，旬月可见。郑帝闻讯有愠色，却不过稍诫而已。

en.text: In 1850, the Ritual Assembly proclaimed that Zheng's Wu had replaced Ming. The Shu Prince Zhu Shenhui and Guangxi (Huai) Prince Jingyin rebelled; Jingyin proclaimed a restoration era 'Fuzhao.' The assembly dispatched Zeng Guofan, Zuo Zongtang, Zheng (Tokugawa) Jiaqi, and Wu (Ii) Naosuke to suppress them. Huai fell in March. Next year Shu general Xiao Huli died of illness; minister Wei Jian held old Chengdu and died cursing traitors with sword in hand. The Shu Prince fled south to Dali.\n\nAfter Chengdu's fall, western troops scattered. Zeng and Wu then had southern troops seal Sichuan prefectures for three days, sweep the land, and kill any robust civilians found outside. Chengdu, Jiange, Meizhou and others were violently looted. Those resisting were slaughtered wherever seized. The Jinsha ran red for weeks. The Zheng emperor reportedly showed displeasure, but issued only mild admonition.

zh.text: 大吴天演二年（1852年），曾国藩、郑家齐入滇。蜀王肉袒降，贬为大理侯，仍得恩养。淮藩僭主靖堙之后以大逆罪流于昆仑洲（南非），并夺其朱氏，改为“彘”姓。如是，贼人所谓“二靖国难”方得告终。同年冬，前明礼部侍郎、湖广布政使郑雕锦率弟子、西南夷六千反。往攻滇南琉璃堡，千总扈熵、沐三友拒之。竞日难克，南逃缅甸。川滇军民多念旧蜀，复往护之，于是官兵烦累，不能追。上闻讯，使曾武成公国藩南出重庆，二巡西南。往后数年，滇地戒严，多有搜杀。土司凋零，野无鸡鸣。

en.text: In 1852, Zeng Guofan and Zheng Jiaqi entered Yunnan. The Shu prince surrendered bare-chested, was reduced to Marquis of Dali, and retained stipends. Jingyin, usurper of Huai, was exiled to Kunlunzhou (South Africa) for high treason; his Zhu surname was stripped and changed to 'Zhi.' Thus ended the so-called 'Twin Jing National Crisis.' That winter, Zheng Diaojin, former vice minister of rites and administrator of Huguang, rebelled with disciples and six thousand southwestern tribesmen. He attacked Liulibao in southern Yunnan but failed against local defenders and fled to Burma. Many Sichuan-Yunnan soldiers and civilians still favored old Shu and shielded him, exhausting imperial troops. Upon hearing this, the emperor sent Duke Wucheng Zeng south from Chongqing for a second southwest inspection. In following years Yunnan remained under martial law with repeated purge-killings; native chieftaincies withered and the wilds fell silent.

zh.text: 大吴大吴天演元年（1850年），蜀、淮、楚三藩反。是为国史所谓“西府倡乱”。其中西北两藩以革命为能事，多有法国激进派之政治举动。然淮藩与之不同。彼淮藩自反王彘靖堙以下，重臣如炀秀清、枭朝贵等，皆以教门土地为联结。举宝莲妖帜，并与景教十字架护身。其实乃近代唯一一起白莲邪教道会门之大叛乱也。\n\n白莲邪教于贵州、广西深耕百年。响应呼喝之乱民愚夫岂止百万？在国朝行新政改革土地后，广西士绅更是多入毂中。于是，吴忠正公直弼既破淮国诸州，乃用三月搜杀教门党徒。查得一人入教，全家灭门。前明功勋士族亦不能免。貌似酷烈，实乃为国除害之猛药。

en.text: In 1850, Shu, Huai, and Chu rebelled - called in national history the 'Western Office Turmoil.' The two northwestern feudatories favored revolutionary politics influenced by French radicals. Huai differed: from usurper Zhi Jingyin down to ministers like Yang Xiuqing and Xiao Chaogui, their coalition centered on sectarian land networks, bearing the Lotus banner and Christian crosses. In essence this became the only major modern rebellion of White Lotus heterodox sectarian movements.\n\nWhite Lotus sects had cultivated Guizhou and Guangxi for a century. Did not chaos respond by the millions? After land reform under the national dynasty, Guangxi gentry entered even deeper. Thus, after Duke Zhongzheng Naosuke broke Huai prefectures, he launched a three-month purge of sect members: one convert found, whole family exterminated. Even meritorious old Ming houses were not spared. Harsh in form, but medicine for the state.

baseline_zh.text: 大吴大吴天演元年（1850年），蜀、淮、楚三藩反。是为国史所谓“西府倡乱”。其中西北两藩以革命为能事，多有法国激进派之政治举动。然淮藩与之不同。彼淮藩自反王彘靖堙以下，重臣如炀秀清、枭朝贵等，皆以教门土地为联结。举宝莲妖帜，并与景教十字架护身。其实乃近代唯一一起白莲邪教道会门之大叛乱也。\n\n白莲邪教于贵州、广西深耕百年。响应呼喝之乱民愚夫岂止百万？在国朝行新政改革土地后，广西士绅更是多入毂中。于是，吴忠正公直弼既破淮国诸州，乃用三月搜杀教门党徒。查得一人入教，全家灭门。前明功勋士族亦不能免。貌似酷烈，实乃为国除害之猛药。

candidate_en.text: In 1850, Shu, Huai, and Chu rebelled - called in national history the 'Western Office Turmoil.' The two northwestern feudatories favored revolutionary politics influenced by French radicals. Huai differed: from usurper Zhi Jingyin down to ministers like Yang Xiuqing and Xiao Chaogui, their coalition centered on sectarian land networks, bearing the Lotus banner and Christian crosses. In essence this became the only major modern rebellion of White Lotus heterodox sectarian movements.\n\nWhite Lotus sects had cultivated Guizhou and Guangxi for a century. Did not chaos respond by the millions? After land reform under the national dynasty, Guangxi gentry entered even deeper. Thus, after Duke Zhongzheng Naosuke broke Huai prefectures, he launched a three-month purge of sect members: one convert found, whole family exterminated. Even meritorious old Ming houses were not spared. Harsh in form, but medicine for the state.

zh.text: 起源自永乐朝大将郑和的吴王世家，或许在繁荣中早已忘却自己的祖先几乎不免于旧时代的阉宦陋习。如今，与南来的国人共和派革命者的联盟缔造了世界上最高效和清廉的官僚团体，长达两个多世纪的专权变法又确保着所有机构及其控制者都或多或少地向吴王殿下及其政治集团效忠。相对于内陆三藩只统治中国的一小部分就棘手不已，南吴郑氏及其羽翼下的精英们正有条不紊地指挥着整个世界，而且他们已经这样做了将近百年有余。

en.text: The Wu princely house, descended from Yongle-era admiral Zheng He, may long since have forgotten that its ancestors were nearly consumed by old eunuch abuses. Yet alliance with southern civic republicans has forged one of the world's most efficient and clean bureaucratic systems, while two centuries of autocratic reform ensured all institutions and controllers remain, to varying degrees, loyal to Prince Wu and his political bloc. Compared with inland feudatories struggling to govern even parts of China, the Zheng elites of Southern Wu direct the whole world in orderly fashion - and have done so for nearly a century.

zh.text: 杭州郑家在闽、吴、越、宁、苗五藩旧省德望遮天，麾下南府雄兵百万。又兼主持变法、抵抗北朝之大功。自然可以让朱明昏主行禅代之事，为一统华夏于一世界帝国的更加宏伟事业奠基。但在南明的其他地方，尤其是被西府故主朱班博联合共和派中的过激分子蛊惑的了西方内地，即使人民已经不念明帜，却也对杭州所行的“科举士族代议制“毫无好感。值此动荡之际，不免有德不配位的狼心狗肺之徒反抗我们定乱代兴的伟业。当然，如果他们没那个胆子，慷慨的大吴至尊又岂会吝啬封侯之位？

en.text: The Zheng house of Hangzhou commands overwhelming prestige in old provinces of Min, Wu, Yue, Ning, and Miao, with a million soldiers under Southern Office banners. It also led reform and resistance against the Northern Court. By all right it can compel abdication from the weak Zhu throne to found a world empire and reunify Huaxia. Yet elsewhere in Southern Ming - especially the western inland influenced by Zhu Banbo and republican radicals - even people no longer loyal to Ming banner despise Hangzhou's 'examination-gentry parliamentarism.' In such turbulence, ambitious and unworthy opportunists will rebel against our great project of restoring order and renewing the age. Of course, should they lack courage, would the generous Supreme of Great Wu begrudge them marquisates?

In such turbulence, ambitious and unworthy opportunists will rebel against our great project of restoring order and renewing the age. Of course, should they lack courage, would the generous Supreme of Great Wu begrudge them marquisates?

all_zh.text: 杭州郑家在闽、吴、越、宁、苗五藩旧省德望遮天，麾下南府雄兵百万。又兼主持变法、抵抗北朝之大功。自然可以让朱明昏主行禅代之事，为一统华夏于一世界帝国的更加宏伟事业奠基。但在南明的其他地方，尤其是被西府故主朱班博联合共和派中的过激分子蛊惑的了西方内地，即使人民已经不念明帜，却也对杭州所行的“科举士族代议制“毫无好感。值此动荡之际，不免有德不配位的狼心狗肺之徒反抗我们定乱代兴的伟业。当然，如果他们没那个胆子，慷慨的大吴至尊又岂会吝啬封侯之位？

all_en.text: The Zheng house of Hangzhou commands overwhelming prestige in old provinces of Min, Wu, Yue, Ning, and Miao, with a million soldiers under Southern Office banners. It also led reform and resistance against the Northern Court. By all right it can compel abdication from the weak Zhu throne to found a world empire and reunify Huaxia. Yet elsewhere in Southern Ming - especially the western inland influenced by Zhu Banbo and republican radicals - even people no longer loyal to Ming banner despise Hangzhou's 'examination-gentry parliamentarism.' In such turbulence, ambitious and unworthy opportunists will rebel against our great project of restoring order and renewing the age. Of course, should they lack courage, would the generous Supreme of Great Wu begrudge them marquisates?

zh.text: 南京颁下禅位诏书，命各府奉郑氏正朔。南府所辖的中央军、财赋机关与海外商馆已开始改用新朝名号，地方总督也须上表，承认郑氏统辖海内外的权力。\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]的军队、官员与地方议局，长期依照同明朝订立的旧约行事。承认易代，便须同吴朝重新确定这些权利；举兵奉明，则须联络各府，准备迎击南府的中央军。亦有人主张退出旧有的隶属，自行主持地方国政。

en.text: 南京颁下禅位诏书，命各府奉郑氏正朔。南府所辖的中央军、财赋机关与海外商馆已开始改用新朝名号，地方总督也须上表，承认郑氏统辖海内外的权力。\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]的军队、官员与地方议局，长期依照同明朝订立的旧约行事。承认易代，便须同吴朝重新确定这些权利；举兵奉明，则须联络各府，准备迎击南府的中央军。亦有人主张退出旧有的隶属，自行主持地方国政。

baseline_zh.text: 朱班博战死，陈东阳遇刺，邓明舆投效，郑雕锦西奔。就连气吞万里的牧仲棠，也受限于北朝内忿，无暇南顾。金陵大殿上已无人能与郑吴至尊正面交锋。按照中国数千年以来的的历史，易姓革命只是早晚的事。但那些或是守旧或是革新的人们却总以为我们这个时代是超越了历史的。但梦想毕竟难以照进现实。\n\n当是时，恰逢吴主诞辰，南京百官不论出身，俱来杭州朝贺。以至于宁王系的明恭宗朝会上唯有故帅朱班博之子，兵部侍郎朱绛臣仍在。如此三日后，吴国辅郝廷疆与吴臣十人入金陵宫城。次日，明恭宗行效尧舜，禅让于吴。郑莒登基称帝，建号大吴。大赦，改元天演，史称天演帝、吴太宗。明恭宗朱阔彬降为明藩王，迁居福建崇明岛。旬月后，阔彬因会饮无度获罪。阔彬大惧，雇民船逃亡东洲。

all_en.text: Zhu Banbo dead in battle, Chen Dongyang assassinated, Deng Mingyu defected, Zheng Diaojin fled west. Even mighty Mu Zhongtang, constrained by northern strife, cannot look south. In the Jinling palace no one remains who can face the Zheng-Wu Supreme directly. By China's millennia of history, dynastic transfer was only a matter of time - yet conservatives and reformers alike believed our age had transcended history. Dreams, however, seldom survive reality.\n\nAt that moment, by coincidence of Wu ruler's birthday, all Nanjing officials went to Hangzhou to offer congratulations, regardless of origin. In the Ming Gongzong court at Nanjing, only Zhu Jiangchen, son of old marshal Zhu Banbo and vice minister of war, remained. Three days later, Wu chancellor Hao Tingjiang and ten Wu ministers entered Jinling palace. Next day Gongzong enacted Yao-Shun style abdication in favor of Wu. Zheng Ju took the throne as emperor, proclaimed Great Wu, granted amnesty, and changed era to Tianyan, remembered as Emperor Tianyan and Wu Taizong. Ming Gongzong Zhu Kuobin was reduced to Ming feudatory prince and moved to Chongming Island in Fujian. A month later he was charged for excessive drinking at banquets; terrified, he hired a civilian vessel and fled eastward.

baseline_zh.text:
开始于吴明易姓的南明内乱，终于在[Date.GetString|v]达到了前所未有的高峰。

前明的支持者、土地改革中被牺牲的地主们和世纪初国人革命的残党，这三派诉求和行为都大相径庭的集团在面对南府郑家的步步紧逼时走到了一起。楚藩朱绛臣、冯云山，蜀藩魏鉴、萧虎力，淮藩朱靖堙、杨秀清等人以“反吴复明，奉天靖难”为旗帜举兵起义。天演帝遂以大将曾国藩、李鸿章、林则徐、吴（井伊氏）直弼率兵进剿。

天演帝登基时，南明名义上已经成为世界第一帝国，此举当即引起了世界哗然，从极东洲到西极英蒽兰，列国纷纷遣使闻讯。而今日，他们的使节也将见证这场东方世界在和平不到半个世纪后就再次燃起的剧烈烽烟。

all_en.text:
The Southern Ming turmoil that began with Wu-Ming dynastic transfer reached an unprecedented peak on [Date.GetString|v].

Former Ming loyalists, landlords sacrificed in land reform, and remnants of the early-century civic revolution - three groups with very different aims - united under pressure from the Zheng house of Southern Office. Zhu Jiangchen and Feng Yunshan of Chu, Wei Jian and Xiao Huli of Shu, Zhu Jingyin and Yang Xiuqing of Huai raised arms under the banner 'Overthrow Wu, restore Ming, pacify national calamity by Heaven's mandate.' Emperor Tianyan sent Zeng Guofan, Li Hongzhang, Lin Zexu, and Wu (Ii) Naosuke to suppress them.

When Tianyan took the throne, Southern Ming was nominally the world's leading empire. This upheaval shocked the world at once; from Far East Continent to distant England, states sent envoys. Today those envoys will witness a fierce eastern conflagration rekindled less than half a century after peace.

en.text:
The Southern Ming turmoil that began with Wu-Ming dynastic transfer reached an unprecedented peak on [Date.GetString|v].

Former Ming loyalists, landlords sacrificed in land reform, and remnants of the early-century civic revolution - three groups with very different aims - united under pressure from the Zheng house of Southern Office. Zhu Jiangchen and Feng Yunshan of Chu, Wei Jian and Xiao Huli of Shu, Zhu Jingyin and Yang Xiuqing of Huai raised arms under the banner 'Overthrow Wu, restore Ming, pacify national calamity by Heaven's mandate.' Emperor Tianyan sent Zeng Guofan, Li Hongzhang, Lin Zexu, and Wu (Ii) Naosuke to suppress them.

When Tianyan took the throne, Southern Ming was nominally the world's leading empire. This upheaval shocked the world at once; from Far East Continent to distant England, states sent envoys. Today those envoys will witness a fierce eastern conflagration rekindled less than half a century after peace.

zh.text: 各府的表章陆续抵达杭州，承认郑氏的新朝。退出旧有隶属的地方也未能组成共同举兵的联盟，中央军与海陆财赋机关因此得以继续运转。\n\n南府经营多年的权力已有了帝国的名分。接下来，各省官员将按新朝的章程任用，军饷和税赋亦须重新核定。海内外的臣民将从这些政令中认识[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]。

en.text: 各府的表章陆续抵达杭州，承认郑氏的新朝。退出旧有隶属的地方也未能组成共同举兵的联盟，中央军与海陆财赋机关因此得以继续运转。\n\n南府经营多年的权力已有了帝国的名分。接下来，各省官员将按新朝的章程任用，军饷和税赋亦须重新核定。海内外的臣民将从这些政令中认识[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]。

baseline_zh.text:
相较于矛盾的全面爆发，富有决断力的南朝政治家们凭借一系列果断地决策延缓了帝国的瓦解。即使遭逢吴明易姓这样的大乱，各地督抚最终也决定不做出任何有效抵抗。接纳了吴国人对于明朝皇帝及其勋贵腐败透顶的说辞。从而维系了华南地区的脆弱和平。

从某种意义上来说，这也意味着日月照临之朝或许早已成为无人愿意殉葬的朽木王朝。那个最后来维护朝廷秩序的皇帝朱阔彬也不过是生不逢时罢了。

虽然如此，这个从四百年的藩镇政治中爬出来的幸存者也失去了很多。战争与和平对峙的年代结束了。但反对者、藩国旧民之间的地域歧视、新的激进派政治团体仍在新时代的阴影下活动者。让这个国家向未来前进的道路蒙上了一层厚重的迷雾。

all_en.text:
Rather than full explosion of contradictions, decisive Southern Court politicians delayed imperial collapse through firm choices. Even amid Wu-Ming dynastic upheaval, regional governors chose no effective resistance and accepted Wu narratives of total corruption by the Ming emperor and his magnates, preserving a fragile peace in South China.

In one sense, this implies the sun-and-moon dynasty had long become rotten wood no one wished to die with. Zhu Kuobin, the last emperor to defend court order, may simply have been born at the wrong time.

Yet this survivor of four centuries of warlord politics lost much. The age of war-peace confrontation ended, but opponents, regional prejudice among old feudatory populations, and new radical groups still move in the shadows of the new era, cloaking the nation's road forward in dense fog.

zh.text: 朱班博的愿景消磨，郑雕锦的顽抗零落。北朝长公主牧沐子曾言襄阳大战的腥风血雨不过是保卫了一场幻梦。如今看来所言不虚。坚决镇乱的曾国藩、死守长沙的冯云山。两面下注的楚军诸将谁能又能说清自己的功过呢？但在俗世凡尘之中，属于楚人的时代结束了......

en.text: Zhu Banbo's vision has worn away; Zheng Diaojin's defiance has scattered. Northern princess Mu Muzi once said the bloodstorm at Xiangyang defended only an illusion. It now seems true. Zeng Guofan's firm pacification, Feng Yunshan's defense of Changsha, Chu generals hedging both sides - who can clearly judge their merit and fault? In mortal dust, however, the age of Chu has ended...

zh.text: 谁有能想到，当初在联邦复明时最揶揄的四川人，如今却成了捍卫明统的最后一道防线？蜀国曾经是北明四百年乱世的避风港。却终不免于屠戮和衰亡。旧蜀军将领的执拗，新蜀军将领的血性，如今都即将在南府军的炮口下化作梦幻泡影。只希望魏鉴等人最后的抵抗能在青史上留下一抹忠魂掠影......

en.text: Who could have imagined that Sichuan people once most mocking federation restoration would become the final line defending Ming legitimacy? Shu was the safe harbor of four centuries of Northern Ming chaos, yet could not escape slaughter and decline. Old and new Shu commanders alike now turn to mirage beneath Southern Office cannon. Let Wei Jian's last stand leave at least a loyal shadow in history.

zh.text: 百年教门联结，一朝万众同心。但面对东南方占据了半个世界的庞然大物，光有热血和智谋恐怕也只能棋差一招。桂林花好月圆，淮土的名将们或许来生还能再欣赏吧。

en.text: A century of sectarian linkage, one morning of shared resolve. Yet against a behemoth ruling half the world from the southeast, courage and strategy still fell one move short. May Huai's famous generals admire Guilin moonlight again in another life.

zh.text: 昔日长江边的那块顽石，至今也没能达到班博老师所期望的高度。或许再被迫携带着一半楚军南渡吕宋的时候，我们和杭州郑家至尊的胜负就已是注定。然而，真正的国人主义者、共和梦想家如果有着我们人民的支持，从来都是不惧一搏的。我们悲痛叹息的只是自己的无能，浪掷了伟大的大明人民的热血罢了......

en.text: That stubborn stone by the Yangtze never reached the height teacher Banbo hoped for. Perhaps when we were forced to carry half the Chu army south to Luzon, our result against Hangzhou was already decided. Yet true civic republicans never fear one last gamble if they still hold the people's support. We lament only our own insufficiency, having squandered the blood of the great Ming people...

zh.text: 西风飘散，彩云南消。我们为自己独立而奋战的这一场大战。终于走到了如今的不幸终点。但好歹这个国家是死在追求独立的道路上，而不是为某些战国大名的征伐侵略而殉葬。

en.text: Western winds disperse, Yunnan colors fade. Our great struggle for independence has reached this unhappy end. At least this country dies pursuing independence, not as burial for some warlord daimyo's campaigns.

zh.text: 我们的战线在一场又一场失败中崩溃了。南府的大兵已经掠过我们的领土，夷平了我们的都城。十万人的军队，在不断地抵抗中还是丧尽。北明战国四百有余年。那时候的一个大国要灭亡，其势也不过如此。而何况我们是死于自己的忠义之中呢！我们能够自责的，也只是自己过于无能罢了。

en.text: Our fronts collapsed through defeat after defeat. Southern Office armies crossed our lands and razed our capital. A hundred-thousand-man force exhausted itself in resistance. In four hundred years of Northern Ming Warring States, a great state's destruction looked no different. We can blame only our own inadequacy.

zh.text: 有时候，历史并不是亲睐于那些有准备的人。一群人用数十年、上百年建立的功业，也会在战争的雷鸣瓦斧中燃烧为残烟缭绕的废墟。吴国历代至尊主以大明和东方世界之名义对于地球的征服或许不会消灭，但他们自身的权力和威势今天走到了历史赋予他们的终点。

en.text: Sometimes history does not favor the prepared. Works built over decades and centuries can burn into smoke and ruins beneath war's thunder and axe. The conquest of Earth undertaken by Wu's supreme rulers in Ming and Eastern name may endure, but their own authority and might have reached the endpoint history assigned today.

zh.text: 是时候从经年的战争中抬起我们光荣的头颅了。自从易姓革命以来的南方乱局，终于在我们的手中以最美好的结局落下帷幕。在四百五十多年前驶入杭州港湾的那艘老旧的官船，如今已变换为在整个世界的波涛冲刷下冲破万难的艨艟巨舰。\n\n扫平那些自称是忠臣孝子的军阀割据之徒，大吴帝国终于完成了联邦制度改革所梦想的”伟大集权“。而郑家的英雄豪杰也终于可以揭下名为忠臣的面纱，堂堂正正地争雄于世界强国之林！而更妙的是，我们在世界舞台上的胜利还早就获得于我们入场之前！

en.text: It is time to raise our glorious heads from years of war. Since the dynastic revolution, southern turmoil has finally ended in the best possible way in our hands. That old official vessel which entered Hangzhou harbor 450 years ago has become a colossal warship that breaks all difficulties beneath the waves of the whole world.\n\nBy sweeping away warlords who call themselves loyal and filial, Great Wu at last fulfills the federation reform dream of 'great centralization.' The heroes of Zheng's house can finally remove the mask of loyal service and contend openly among world powers. Better yet, our victory on the world stage was won even before we stepped onto it.

zh.text: 这场震惊了世界的闹剧最终没有任何赢家。在长期的战争消磨中，南朝东西双方都耗尽了自己的战争潜力和工业底蕴。或许在不久的将来，这样脆弱的和平将会被打破，而更加伟大和血腥的时代将会到来。但至少现在的我们获得了喘息之机......

en.text: This world-shaking farce ended with no winner. In prolonged attrition, east and west of the Southern Court exhausted war potential and industrial foundations alike. Perhaps this fragile peace will soon break and an even greater, bloodier age will come. But for now, at least, we have breathing room...

zh.text: 联军已击败吴朝的中央军。奉明的旗号曾将各府聚到一处，如今南京的帝位、中央的官缺与各省的兵权，都等待胜利者处置。\n\n朱姓王室可以重掌朝政，也可以由获胜的地方政府主持其国政。军中与地方议局的共和派则要求召集国人代表，把战争中形成的联合带入新的政府。此次决定，将为南朝的战后秩序定下名分。

en.text: 联军已击败吴朝的中央军。奉明的旗号曾将各府聚到一处，如今南京的帝位、中央的官缺与各省的兵权，都等待胜利者处置。\n\n朱姓王室可以重掌朝政，也可以由获胜的地方政府主持其国政。军中与地方议局的共和派则要求召集国人代表，把战争中形成的联合带入新的政府。此次决定，将为南朝的战后秩序定下名分。

baseline_zh.text: 由郑氏乱臣贼子所兴起的这场内乱，终于以我们这些正道之士的胜利落下帷幕。这个时代不是值得称道的时代。忠臣和忠臣之间相互杀戮，共和派和共和派相互攻讦。郑氏原本并不是旧日明廷中最腐朽的一帮人，但他们对于权力的渴望以及他们在旧国家里独一无二的地位却将他们及我们全部人推向战乱的深渊。作为胜利者，我们必须确保这一切再不重演。

all_en.text: The internal chaos raised by Zheng traitors has finally ended in the victory of those on the righteous path. This is not an age to praise. Loyalists killed loyalists; republicans attacked republicans. Zheng's group was not originally the most rotten faction of old Ming, yet their thirst for power and singular status in the old state pushed all of us into the abyss of war. As victors, we must ensure this never repeats.

zh.text: 战争已然结束，胜果为他人所夺。我们和新朝的关系尴尬了起来。自北明以来，中原各省行诸侯政治不是什么新闻。但今日战胜之国若是转变枪口对准我们，我们难道就有信息抗拒”王师“吗？

zh.text: 最近一段时间的内乱迫使我们被拉到了与和族人的谈判桌上。他们要求我们以返还占日领土为帮助我们打赢这场战争的代价。这实在是奇耻大辱。但我们也毫无办法。或许以后我们处于更有利的状况下时，我们的大军可以一雪前耻。

en.text: Recent internal turmoil forced us to the negotiating table with the Wa. They demand return of occupied Japanese territories in exchange for helping us win this war. It is a profound humiliation, but we have little choice. Perhaps when conditions favor us later, our armies can erase this shame.

zh.text: 最近一段时间的军事失利迫使我们被拉到了与和族人的谈判桌上。他们要求我们以返还占日领土为帮助我们打赢这场战争的代价。这实在是奇耻大辱。但我们也毫无办法，或许下一次我们占领别国领土又与人开战的时候，应该更积极地对那些领土进行防御。

en.text: Recent military losses forced us to negotiate with the Wa. They demand the return of occupied Japanese territories as the price for wartime support. It is humiliating, but we have little choice. Next time we occupy foreign lands and fight, we should defend those holdings more actively.

zh.text: 随着我们在南明的内乱中击败了敌人并重新占领了日本被侵占的领土九州。是时候向那个窃据我们土地的政权发布最后通牒了。日出之国不会再容忍这种对我们尊严的的冒犯。前任幕府割让土地的决策是错误的！

en.text: Having defeated our enemies in Southern Ming strife and reoccupied Japanese Kyushu, it is time to issue an ultimatum to the regime that usurped our lands. The Land of the Rising Sun will no longer tolerate this insult to our dignity. The old shogunate's land cession was a mistake.

zh.text: 最近一段时间的军事失利迫使我们被拉到了与和族人的谈判桌上。他们要求我们以返还占日领土为帮助我们打赢这场战争的代价。这实在是奇耻大辱。但我们也毫无办法，或许下一次我们占领别国领土又与人开战的时候，应该更积极地对那些领土进行防御。

en.text: Recent military losses forced us to negotiate with the Wa. They demand the return of occupied Japanese territories as the price for helping us win this war. It is humiliating, but we have little choice. Perhaps next time we occupy foreign lands and go to war, we should defend those lands more actively.

zh.text: 臣闻天朝有兴战之策，小邦亦有御敌之图。论文有孔孟道德之文章，论武有孙吴韬略之兵法。又闻陛下选股肱之将，起精锐之师，来侵臣境。水泽之地，山海之洲，自有其备，岂肯跪途而奉之乎？\n——日本南朝怀良亲王

en.text: The Celestial Court has plans to wage war; small states have plans to resist. In letters we have Confucian moral classics, in arms we have Sun and Wu's stratagems. You may choose your finest generals and elite troops to invade our borders, but in marsh and mountain and island sea we have our own preparations. Why should we kneel in the road and submit?\n- Prince Kanenaga of Southern Japan

zh.text: 这场震惊了世界的闹剧最终没有任何赢家。在长期的战争消磨中，南朝东西双方都耗尽了自己的战争潜力和工业底蕴。或许在不久的将来，这样脆弱的和平将会被打破，而更加伟大和血腥的时代将会到来。但至少现在的我们获得了喘息之机......

en.text: This world-shaking farce ended with no winner. In prolonged attrition, east and west of the Southern Court exhausted war potential and industrial foundations alike. Perhaps this fragile peace will soon break and an even greater, bloodier age will come. But for now, at least, we have breathing room...

zh.text: 我们用尽权力推动的战争终于还是失败了。南明，或者说现在的大吴帝国中就是一个太过强大而对手。或许在我们用更长久的时间在阴影中恢复过来后，我们的东方岛国才能再一次追求自身独立。又或许这种对自身地位的不满不过是更阴暗情绪的反应。在乡间、城下町里，许多声音都在说着我们这次的流血是贪婪和暴政带来的惨剧。作为一个学习大朝而建立的国家，我们应该学会知足。

en.text: The war we pushed with all our power has still ended in defeat. Southern Ming - now the Great Wu Empire - proved too strong an opponent. Perhaps only after recovering for a long time in the shadows can our eastern island state pursue independence again. Or perhaps this dissatisfaction with status is merely a darker impulse. In villages and castle towns many voices now say our bloodshed was a tragedy born of greed and tyranny. As a state founded by learning from the great court, we should know contentment.

zh.text: 南朝内战使九州重新成为日本朝野关注的焦点。郑氏在当地经营的港口、商路与驻军，关系着吴朝的海上力量，也牵动着日本领主和商人的利益。\n\n吴朝与反吴诸府都在争取日本出兵，并以战后交还郑氏所持九州为条件。支援哪一方，将决定日本军队渡海后的敌友，以及战后向谁索取出兵的报偿。

en.text: 南朝内战使九州重新成为日本朝野关注的焦点。郑氏在当地经营的港口、商路与驻军，关系着吴朝的海上力量，也牵动着日本领主和商人的利益。\n\n吴朝与反吴诸府都在争取日本出兵，并以战后交还郑氏所持九州为条件。支援哪一方，将决定日本军队渡海后的敌友，以及战后向谁索取出兵的报偿。

baseline_zh.text: 郑家和日本的统治者都是老相识了。说实话，他们虽然已经是中国之天下人。但按照唐土历史的惯例，天下人更进一步也并非是前无古人，反倒显得郑家隐忍太久了。然而，郑吴的人中就是对自己的实力过于自信。阴影中，反对郑家势力的人们正在集结。这将是百年未有的时机，如果明国（吴国）内战爆发，日本作为明廷诸外藩中最大的一个，必须迅速做好维护我们利益，乃至神州秩序的准备。

all_en.text: The Zheng house and Japan's rulers are old acquaintances. Frankly, though they already became masters of China, in Tang-land precedent it is hardly unprecedented for masters to seek more; Zheng restraint has perhaps lasted too long. Yet Zheng-Wu elites have grown overconfident. In the shadows, opponents gather. This is a once-in-a-century opening. If civil war erupts in Ming (Wu), Japan - the largest outer feudatory of the Ming court - must quickly prepare to defend our interests and perhaps the order of Shenzhou itself.

zh.text: 自南吴军队协助先太阁丰臣秀吉夺取日本政权后，我们的地位便久处明廷之下，渐渐成为其臣妾。最终不仅失去了九州岛，海关贸易的权力一并为杭州西府所设置的“东洋领事府”所控制。然而，风水自古是轮流转的。在南明联邦崩溃的洪流中，当代幕府将军[SCOPE.sCharacter('japanese_ruler').GetIdeology.GetName]攥紧了时代的脉络，赢得了来之不易的独立。

en.text: Ever since the armies of Wu principality aided the late Taikō Toyotomi Hideyoshi in seizing power in Japan, our position has long remained beneath the Southern Ming court led by the prince in Hangzhou. In time, we gradually reduced to that of a vassal and consort to the Ming-nese rule. In the end, not only was Kyushu lost, but the authority over customs and maritime trade was likewise placed under the control of the “Eastern Ocean Consular Office” established by the Chines. Yet fortune has always turned by the change of ages. Amid the torrent of the Southern Ming Federation’s collapse, the current Shogun, [SCOPE.sCharacter('japanese_ruler').GetIdeology.GetName], seized the pulse of the times and won a hard-earned independence.

zh.text: “奉日本国大君之命，谨照会中国大朝皇帝陛下。自今以后，日本不复居藩臣之列，凡疆土、政令、兵马、通商诸事，皆由本国自主裁断。旧日恩义，非敢忘也；然天地既改，名分亦当随时而正。愿两国各守疆界，修旧好而绝旧制。”

en.text: “By command of the Taikun of Japan, we hereby respectfully address His Majesty, Emperor of the Great Chinese Court. From this day forth, Japan shall no longer stand among the tributary states. All matters of territory, governance, military affairs, and commerce shall be judged and administered independently by this country. The old bonds of favor and obligation are not forgotten; yet as Heaven and Earth have changed, so too must names and stations be rectified with the times. May our two countries each keep to their own frontiers, preserve the old amity, and sever the old order.”

zh.text: 盛夏的酷热使年迈的[SCOPE.sCharacter('japanese_shogun').GetPrimaryRoleTitle][SCOPE.sCharacter('japanese_shogun').GetFullName]健康状况急剧恶化，最终于本月早些时候薨逝。他的继承人，锐意改革的[SCOPE.sCharacter('japanese_heir').GetFullName]如今执掌日本。他梦想一个新的、强大的幕府政权已久，藩臣们也多尊重这一愿景。

en.text: The sweltering heat of midsummer caused the health of the aged [SCOPE.sCharacter('japanese_shogun').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('japanese_shogun').GetFullName] to deteriorate rapidly, and he ultimately passed away earlier this month. His heir, the reform-minded [SCOPE.sCharacter('japanese_heir').GetFullName], now rules Japan. He has long dreamed of a new and powerful shogunate, and many among the vassals respect this vision.

zh.text: “炎暑方炽，先公大渐，遂至薨逝，举国臣民莫不哀恸。然国势之危，不容久溺于悲。今新公继统，宜振纪纲，讲武备，开学术，察万国之形势，择其长而用之，以富国强兵、再造幕府。此非为一姓之私计，实为日本万世之大策也。”

en.text: “As the summer heat reached its height, our late lord fell gravely ill and at last passed from this world, leaving all the subjects of the realm in mourning. Yet the perilous state of the country permits us no long indulgence in grief. Now that the new lord has inherited the succession, he must restore discipline, strengthen the military, open the path of learning, observe the conditions of all nations, and adopt their strengths, so that the country may be enriched, the army strengthened, and the shogunate renewed. This is no private design for the sake of one house; it is truly a grand policy for Japan for all ages to come.”

Yet the perilous state of the country permits us no long indulgence in grief. Now that the new lord has inherited the succession, he must restore discipline, strengthen the military, open the path of learning, observe the conditions of all nations, and adopt their strengths, so that the country may be enriched, the army strengthened, and the shogunate renewed. This is no private design for the sake of one house; it is truly a grand policy for Japan for all ages to come.”

zh.text: 将军的床被移到窗前。仆人们本指望从海上吹来的凉风，配合上手中的扇子，能稍微减轻暑气。床尾摆着一只打开的冰匣，他的额头上覆着湿布。\n\n今天没有风。燥热的空气在落日下翻涌。闷热而无情，笼罩一切。他已看不清下方海浪的形状。

en.text: The Shōgun's bed had been moved to face the window. His attendants had hoped the cool air blowing in from the sea would supplement their fans. A chest of ice sat open at the foot of the bed, and a wet cloth across his forehead.\n\nThere was no wind, today. The air rippled beneath the setting sun. Merciless, all-enveloping. He could no longer make out the shape of the waves below.

zh.text: 丰臣氏借明吴之力平定战国，又与郑氏共争朝鲜。两家的旧盟维持了海东秩序，也使九州的吴人驻军与日本诸侯结下了绵延数代的利害。如今南朝大局已定，朝廷开始议论东征：将西军旧部调往海东，以天皇和德川分掌日本，收九州、四国为直辖。远洋诸藩的军饷、商路和驻军同样等着南京作出安排。

en.text: The Toyotomi unified Japan with Ming and Wu assistance and fought beside the Zheng in Korea. The court now considers dividing authority between the Toyotomi, Tokugawa and Emperor, with Kyushu and Shikoku under direct Wu administration. The expedition would also remove old western officers from the mainland. Overseas garrisons and commerce still compete for the same ships and revenue.

zh.text: 朱班博整顿湖广时，曾修复襄阳工事，召集青年军官任教，又用军工铁件向川蜀换取粮食。伤兵与退伍军人分入后勤、屯垦卫所，留在襄阳的共和派协助总督府重建书院。\n\n二十年间，总督府的军队、田赋与学籍渐成一体。如今杭州催交兵饷，各府的调令也愈加频繁。湖广须重新核定屯田与兵员，充实书院，接续上游的粮运，以备南朝再起战事。

en.text: 朱班博整顿湖广时曾修复襄阳工事，召集青年军官任教，又用军工铁件向川蜀换取粮食。伤兵与退伍军人分入后勤、屯垦卫所，留在襄阳的共和派协助总督府改造岳麓书院。二十年间，总督府的军队、田赋、学政渐成一体。加上朝廷中有陈东阳为奥援。时人多以襄阳兵为“新西府”的魁首。更是南明联邦建国不可或缺的柱石。\n\n然而，曾经极力支持朱斑博的郑家屡屡在朝廷中指责襄阳方面拖欠税款、瞒报户籍。又外放石元辅、林汉涵等亲湖广派的南兵高层和许多亲近湖广的共和派官员。一系列迹象表明我们必须做好最坏准备。重新核定屯田兵农丁口，接续上游的粮运，在书院中造势拉拢士子。以备不时之需。

zh.text: 襄阳书院曾为湖广造就军官、教员与办事之吏。恢复各县选送生员的办法，使总督府的政令有人施行，地方的粮饷有人核算。

en.text: 襄阳的岳麓书院是湖广派官员、仪政士子的精神中心。但是它建立时起就奉行着忠于南朝的“爱国”教育。在南府频频发难的危急时刻，我们必须整顿人员，让岳麓教员们在我们的指挥下逐渐将把持朝政的倭吴丑类和朱明皇室区分开。以团结我内部思想以备不测。

zh.text: 南京的帝统、杭州的兵财与各府的地方权力，须有共同遵守的章程。重新议定任官、赋额与军费，使朱姓天子仍能主持南朝的国政。

en.text: 在新政完全实现已不可阻挡的今天，局势已经逐渐脱离了杭州南府的掌控——这是好的！由此，我们需要重新平衡杭州的势力与西府各省。就像过去的“大礼议”改变了北明中期的国家格局，我们应当在各省代表共同支持的如今，从速召开额外的大礼议会（南明国家议会）和内阁会议。重新议定任官、赋额、军费、省制。以北朝、西夷、东洲施行的宪法/礼法制度为参照，重整政治。或可使朱姓天子终于挣脱桎梏，主持南朝国政。

zh.text: 南京终于收到各府签押的新约。任官、田赋与军费的争议，被列入朝廷与各府共同遵守的章程。朱姓王室保有帝统，南府仍经营其广阔的海陆产业，地方总督也得以凭明文约定参与国政。\n\n这些约定经历了反复交涉。每一笔赋额、每一个官缺，都牵动着一支军队或一群士人的生计。如今，[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]得以沿用旧有的名号，开始组织一套新的政治生活。

en.text: 随着各省学政（南明国会议员）在大礼议上以绝对多数表明了对新法的支持。以中央政府为核心的任官、田赋与军费改革终于统合为广泛承认的系列条陈，写入南明的国家“礼法”。依照新法，明廷，或者说现政权的明廷，终于结束了自西历15世纪初塞王之乱以来的地方割据的状态。\n\n当然，在行政上的统一于陈东阳重设行省布政司时就完成了。但那时的政策并未命令废止“封君”制度，也没有确定中央政府和地方的权力边界。只是南、西两府面临北朝南下的危机空前团结，以至于无人对南京（实际是杭州）统一执行军政事权、任免官员、捕杀不从的力量发出异议。即使有，也早在两府大兵的铁蹄铁铳下碾为尘埃——如今，这一切的努力终于刻入石头，万世难改。

zh.text: 首辅护卫在核验随行人员时，查获了一封私换护卫的密信。接应地点随即被封锁，涉案者分别收押，陈东阳得以返回住处。\n\n清查很快触及承办军需与海运的人家。他们同南府和各地营伍往来密切，掌握着朝廷正在查核的旧账。公开案情，可以使内阁继续追究这些关系；秘密审办，则须依靠护卫与亲信维持首辅的安全。

en.text: 首辅护卫在核验随行人员时，查获了一封伪造的换防手令。携带密信的人员及其同伙很快被锦衣卫和大理寺抓捕，按照身份和参与事情分别收押。首辅本人被当即送往安全地点，在案犯落网后才得以返回住处。\n\n对案犯的调查一发不可收拾。触及承办军需、海运的一些关键岗位的官员。而这些嫌疑人又同各省名绅大户乃至圈禁的旧藩邦君往来密切。这些人似乎掌握着刑部、大理寺在首辅要求下秘密核查的一些走私案的关键信息。然而，大理寺和锦衣卫对于下一步的行动产生了分歧。由大理寺审办，对刑事官员们公开案情，被内阁认为是可以从明面上开始大规模的内部调查，方便行事。锦衣卫方面则坚持应该封锁消息、秘密调查，不能打草惊蛇，以麻痹逆贼、防止事态扩大。

zh.text: 南朝易代的消息传来，北方军中又有人提起牧仲棠当年的南征。如今郑氏与各府决裂，长江以南的驻军和粮运都将卷入争夺，统一的主张重新进入朝廷的议论。\n\n边将请拨军饷，派员联络湖广。国内正在推进的地权改革同样需要官员、经费与可靠的驻军。[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]必须决定，将这些力量用于国内的治理，还是重新投入南方战争。

en.text: 倭吴叛明称制的消息传来，江北大臣纷纷弹冠相庆。更有人提起牧家天子当年御辇南下的盛举。毕竟伪吴郑狗与西府各省决裂互斗中无暇北顾。南征统一或可一举成功。\n\n有心人的策动下，边将请拨军饷，并派员联络湖广的“有识之士”。然而，我朝却不是什么太平兴国之世界。国内正在推进的地权改革仍在继续。如果在改革期间卷入南朝的混战，未来是福是祸仍未可知也。

en.text:
#bold Succession Pressure#!: #v [Country.MakeScope.ScriptValue('nesnd_south_pressure_value')|1] / 100#!

zh.text:
陈东阳自西秦流亡南明，与吴王郑钦合力推行改制，国人共和派由此进入了南朝权力的中心。改制所倚仗的军队、财赋机关和海外商馆，至今多由南府掌握；内阁拟议的人事与田产新章，也须经这些机构传行。

如今陈东阳每次出行，船只、侍从与沿途接应的人手都要另行核定。内阁请求由[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]拨给专款，调集听命于首辅的亲卫，承担随行和居所的警戒。朝廷应当为这位改革领袖付出多少，又肯交给他多少调度人手的权力，已经列入今日的议程。

$nesnd_chen.finance_rules$

en.text:
Chen Dongyang entered Southern Ming as an exile from the Western Qin revolution. His alliance with Prince Zheng Qin brought the national republicans into the centre of southern government. Much of the army, revenue administration and overseas trading network remained under the Southern Command; the Cabinet depended on those institutions to carry out its appointments and land measures.

Every journey now requires another arrangement of ships, attendants and local escorts. The Cabinet asks [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] to fund a guard answerable to the Chief Minister. Its pay and authority are before the court today.

$nesnd_chen.finance_rules$

zh.text: 陈东阳在前往东洲讲学的航船上遭到袭击。铳弹贯穿了他的肩臂，随从将他抬入船舱，停船延医。入夜以后，渡口传出陈公尚在人世的消息，赶来探视的门生才各自退去。\n\n这位从西秦革命走到南明改制的政治家，如今负伤卧床。他在南方的追随者将遇刺经过刊入报章，要求朝廷查明随行人手的来历；各府送往内阁的文书，也开始追问南府经办的船务和警戒。朝廷围绕新政与权力归属的争执，又添了一桩不能置之不问的血案。

en.text: Chen Dongyang was attacked aboard the vessel carrying him east to lecture. A shot passed through his shoulder and arm. His attendants took him below and summoned a physician. Only after nightfall did his waiting students hear that he was still alive.\n\nThe veteran of the Western Qin revolution and the southern reforms now lay wounded. His followers published accounts of the attack and demanded an inquiry into the escort. Provincial correspondence questioned the Southern Command’s shipping arrangements, adding the bloodshed to the struggle over reform and political authority.

zh.text: 陈东阳的航船尚未启行，船工便发现了一只封口被换过的食盒。经手的随从供出了接应之人，循线搜得的荐书又牵出了替首辅安排船务的官员。渡口当日封闭，陈东阳在门生陪同下返回官署。\n\n西秦革命流亡者与南府郑氏共同主持改革的岁月，原已在党争中渐渐远去。如今一场未遂的谋杀，使陈东阳的行止成为[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]朝野议论的国事。共和派继续以他的名义发表文章，内阁则派员审问人犯，将船务和随行人员的任用一并查核。

en.text: Before Chen’s vessel departed, a boatman noticed that a food box had been resealed. The attendant who handled it named his contact. Letters recovered from the contact’s rooms implicated officials who had arranged the journey. The landing was closed and Chen returned to his offices with his students.\n\nParty conflict had eroded the old alliance between the Western Qin exiles and the Zheng command. The attempted murder made Chen’s movements a matter of public debate across [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. Republicans continued publishing in his name, while the Cabinet investigated the prisoners and the appointment of the escort.

all_zh.text: 陈东阳的航船尚未启行，船工便发现了一只封口被换过的食盒。经手的随从供出了接应之人，循线搜得的荐书又牵出了替首辅安排船务的官员。渡口当日封闭，陈东阳在门生陪同下返回官署。\n\n西秦革命流亡者与南府郑氏共同主持改革的岁月，原已在党争中渐渐远去。如今一场未遂的谋杀，使陈东阳的行止成为[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]朝野议论的国事。共和派继续以他的名义发表文章，内阁则派员审问人犯，将船务和随行人员的任用一并查核。

all_en.text: Before Chen’s vessel departed, a boatman noticed that a food box had been resealed. The attendant who handled it named his contact. zh.text: 官署中的铳声惊动了值夜人员。陈东阳中弹倒在案边，医官赶来取出弹丸时，他的肩臂已经失血甚多。守卫封住院门，登楼报信，门下诸生在外等到天明，才听到陈公醒转的消息。\n\n这位从西秦革命走到南明改制的政治家，如今负伤卧床。他在南方的追随者将遇刺经过刊入报章，要求朝廷查明刺客如何进入首辅居所。专任亲卫的设立已将这处官署置于内阁的调度之下，院内的职役、引荐和交接由谁负责，须由朝廷逐项追究。

en.text: A shot rang through the guarded offices. Chen fell beside his desk and lost much blood before the physician removed the bullet. The watch sealed the gates. His students waited outside until dawn for word that he had regained consciousness.\n\nHis followers published accounts of the attack and demanded to know how the assailant had entered the residence. The Cabinet had assumed responsibility for its security. The appointments, recommendations and handovers inside the compound would now be examined by the court.

zh.text: 陈东阳暂缓了远行，仍在官署批阅奏牍。厨房送来的汤药经过两道签押，守卫直到夜间才发现封口被换过。医官赶到时，陈东阳已经不能言语。\n\n天明后，内阁封存了药盏与值夜名册。南方进步派失去了主持改制的领袖，各府派驻南京的官员聚在门外，等候朝廷公布继任人选。

Provincial delegates gathered outside, waiting for the appointment of a successor.

zh.text: 南朝的天下，究竟是朱氏皇帝的天下，还是郑氏开拓出来的天下？南京的诏书遍传诸邦，杭州的商船、税吏与兵舰也遍至诸邦。三百年来奉明正朔的名义与百余年来吴国经营海陆的功业，终于被摆到了同一张案上。\n\n襄樊大营奉朱氏正朔，四川士人仍在争论南府的新政；南洋总督与日本诸侯，则盘算着改朝换代将向他们索取多少钱粮、土地和兵员。各国的札子陆续送到南京与杭州。待到奉表称臣不再足以两全，今日的主张便要由各自的军队承担。

en.text: Does the southern realm belong to the Zhu emperors, or to the Zheng rulers whose fleets and armies have carried it across the seas? Edicts travel from Nanjing to the same countries reached by Hangzhou’s merchants, tax collectors and warships. Centuries of Ming legitimacy now stand against the achievements and resources of Wu.\n\nXiangfan remains loyal to the Ming. Sichuan debates the reforms of the Southern Court, while overseas governors and Japanese lords consider the money, land and troops a new dynasty might demand. Their answers will soon have to be sustained by their own forces.

zh.text: 各府尚未结成举兵反对新朝的联盟。复函仍在追问旧有的赋额、军费、地方任官和海外贸易安排。朝廷需要逐项答复，才能把一次禅让变为可以施行的秩序。

en.text: The provinces have not formed an armed coalition against the new court. Their replies demand answers on revenues, military expenses, appointments and overseas trade. The Zheng house must settle these questions if the abdication is to secure its rule.

candidate_en.text: The provinces have not formed an armed coalition against the new court. Their replies demand answers on revenues, military expenses, appointments and overseas trade. The Zheng house must settle these questions if the abdication is to secure its rule.

all_zh.text: 各府尚未结成举兵反对新朝的联盟。复函仍在追问旧有的赋额、军费、地方任官和海外贸易安排。朝廷需要逐项答复，才能把一次禅让变为可以施行的秩序。

all_en.text: The provinces have not formed an armed coalition against the new court. Their replies demand answers on revenues, military expenses, appointments and overseas trade. The Zheng house must settle these questions if the abdication is to secure its rule.

zh.text: 诸府已经与中央决裂，预定接驾的地方政府又发生了变故。护送队伍无法照原路启程。留在京中的官员仍能传递消息，也必须应付新朝发下的命令。

en.text: The provinces have broken with the centre, but the government expected to receive the court has changed. The escort cannot follow its planned route. Officials remaining in the capital can still exchange messages while confronting the orders of the new dynasty.

zh.text: 停战以后，朝廷仍驻在地方。旧都的印信已经更换，拥明诸府还保留着自己的兵饷和官署。行在可以休养财力、结交盟友，再谋收复旧都。

en.text: After the truce, the court remains in the provinces. New seals govern the old capital; the Ming supporters retain their own revenues, forces and offices. The provisional court may rebuild its finances, seek allies and prepare to recover the capital.

candidate_en.text: After the truce, the court remains in the provinces. New seals govern the old capital; the Ming supporters retain their own revenues, forces and offices. The provisional court may rebuild its finances, seek allies and prepare to recover the capital.

all_zh.text: 停战以后，朝廷仍驻在地方。旧都的印信已经更换，拥明诸府还保留着自己的兵饷和官署。行在可以休养财力、结交盟友，再谋收复旧都。

all_en.text: After the truce, the court remains in the provinces. New seals govern the old capital; the Ming supporters retain their own revenues, forces and offices. The provisional court may rebuild its finances, seek allies and prepare to recover the capital.

zh.text: 在新的战争中控制南京及吴朝首都，并满足实际胜利条件后，议定复国安排。

en.text: In a new war, take Nanjing and the Wu capital and meet the terms for a restoration settlement.

candidate_en.text: In a new war, take Nanjing and the Wu capital and meet the terms for a restoration settlement.

all_zh.text: 在新的战争中控制南京及吴朝首都，并满足实际胜利条件后，议定复国安排。

all_en.text: In a new war, take Nanjing and the Wu capital and meet the terms for a restoration settlement.

zh.text: 对应靖难对峙或战争仍在进行；湖广或四川有独立、拥明、控制首都且未由另一玩家执掌的接应政府。

en.text: The succession confrontation or war is still underway. A Ming supporter in Huguang or Sichuan must be independent, hold its capital and be free of another player's control.

zh.text: 本国明确支持此路线，签署有效#v 36个月#!的盟书；立场在#v 6个月#!内固定。改变立场、对吴交战、改投其他宗主或盟书到期时，签署失效。吴方大陆条款包括中国范围州省整合；日本条款包括让出本国实际持有的四国及九州，保留其他辖地。 与中央关系#p +15#!。

all_zh.text: 诸府约章

all_en.text: The Provincial Accord

zh.text: 内阁将新编的盟书送到了[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]。朱氏天子继续主持国政，各府保留自己的政府、领土和既有法制，以共同的朝廷协调诸邦事务。随文送来的还有一册任官与赋额的议事记录。来使要带回本国的正式答复，好让这些条款在日后的朝会上有据可循。

en.text: The cabinet has delivered its proposed accord to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. The Zhu emperor would continue to preside over the common court, while the provincial governments retain their territories and existing legal systems. The envoy carries records of discussions on appointments and revenues and seeks a formal reply to place before the court.

candidate_en.text: The cabinet has delivered its proposed accord to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. The Zhu emperor would continue to preside over the common court, while the provincial governments retain their territories and existing legal systems. The envoy carries records of discussions on appointments and revenues and seeks a formal reply to place before the court.

all_zh.text: 内阁将新编的盟书送到了[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]。朱氏天子继续主持国政，各府保留自己的政府、领土和既有法制，以共同的朝廷协调诸邦事务。随文送来的还有一册任官与赋额的议事记录。来使要带回本国的正式答复，好让这些条款在日后的朝会上有据可循。

all_en.text: The cabinet has delivered its proposed accord to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. The Zhu emperor would continue to preside over the common court, while the provincial governments retain their territories and existing legal systems. The envoy carries records of discussions on appointments and revenues and seeks a formal reply to place before the court.

zh.text: 郑氏的使者带来了改设州省的议案。参加新朝的大陆诸邦将交出中国范围内的辖地，由中央统一施政，原有田契、工坊和人口仍留在当地。地方官员须将各衙署的簿册逐项移交。使者要求在文书上写明同意的范围，署名用印以后，再由朝廷与各府共同等候改制。

en.text: The Zheng envoy proposes to bring the mainland polities under direct provincial rule. Their Chinese territories covered by the agreement would pass to the central government, together with responsibility for their people, estates and workshops. The envoy has set out the lands to be transferred and now awaits our consent.

zh.text: 自北明藩镇割据以来，南京朝廷与地方诸府之间的往来，常伴随着贡赋、军役和名分的争执。郑氏主持南朝政务之后，海外贸易和直属军队又将这些旧关系编入了一张遍及海内的帝国网络。如今，各府已经选定自己的盟书，中央需要按所许条件安排官员与经费，使这场易代争议有一个可以共同接受的结果。

en.text: For centuries, relations between the court and the provincial governments have involved tribute, military obligations and dynastic authority. Zheng administration added overseas trade and a standing army to this imperial network. With the governments now choosing their accords, the central administration must provide the officials and funds promised in those agreements.

zh.text: 围绕易代的交涉已延续两年。各府仍按自己的主张处理政务，中央送出的盟书也未能促成一次共同承认的定议。商旅继续往来，军队驻守原地，诸府的名号与辖境沿用至今。\n\n朝廷可以据此停办此次会商，将现行安排录为成约。此后君臣之间的往来，仍由各自保有的条约和实际权力决定。

en.text: Two years of negotiations have produced no common settlement. Provincial governments continue to administer their territories, and the central accords have not secured a general agreement. The existing borders, governments and treaties remain in force.\n\nThe court may now end this round of negotiations and recognize the arrangements currently in place.
